sentence: From 2022-02-02 to 2026-11-03 (239 weekly decisions, both traded at the open), labels set with the pre-market price returned +39.1% a year (worst drawdown -30.6%) against +43.1% (-30.6%) for labels set at the previous close; the two agreed on 89% of stock-weeks. Sharpe ratio difference -0.10 (95% block-bootstrap CI [-0.38, +0.14]): deciding before the open has been **not distinguishable from deciding on the previous close**.
